articles.title: Stocks to Watch: United, Spirit, Boeing, Tesla
articles.mainIdea: Stocks to Watch: United, Spirit, Boeing, Tesla
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Stocks to Watch: United, Spirit, Boeing, Tesla. ↘️ United Airlines (UAL): The carrier said that it's trimming capacity as jet-fuel prices soar, but that higher sales helped it offset additional fuel costs in the first quarter. Shares fell 5.5%. ↗️ Spirit Aviation (FLYYQ): The stock soared 150%, compounding on yesterday's gains on news that Spirit Airlines is in talks with the Trump administration about a deal to salvage the troubled budget carrier. Related tickers mentioned: ASM.AS, BA, DTE.DE, FLYY, FLYYQ, GOOG, TSLA, UAL.
